name: Finnex Planted+ 24/7 KLC 24 in (KL-C24A)
description: Finnex's automated 24/7 cycle light: a wireless remote drives a full dawn-noon-dusk-moonlight loop. The 24 in KLC carries 32 white + 16 red + 24 RGB diodes; Finnex publishes 7000K for the daytime white channel but no luminous flux, so light.lumens is omitted rather than estimated. coverageLitres converts the manufacturer's 15-20 US gal recommendation (57-76 L). photoperiodHours 10 approximates the daylight-dominant portion of the fixture's continuous 24/7 program.
